description: The dossier. Without a key, a preview: the question, the causal chain as link ends with a status per link (observed, consistent, untested, contradicted), two constants with their source quotes, the review verdict, and counts for the rest (constants, constraints, alternatives, conjectures, trajectories). A member key opens the complete dossier: every constant, bounded constraints, alternatives with their discriminators, checks, falsifiers, paths and implications.

key.description: A member key (dfk1…), issued with the plan; omit it for the free sample

title: Read the reasoning dossier of a signal
